messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: metering.alerts.token_drift (prod) — emitter vs ledger delta > 2% for 20m. Multiple customer overage flags firing. Paging oncall.

maria_oncall: I'm on it, joining incident channel. preliminary checks: kafka consumer lags? :eyes:

sam_billing: Confirmed: kafka topic usage-events-prod lag ~750k messages, latest offset ~120s behind. Some downstream batch job shows delayed writes. Seeing overage alerts for 3 customers (acct A, B, C).

raj_analytics: I'm pulling the aggregator diffs now; snapshot shows token counts from emitter are higher than ledger by ~1.8M tokens in last 45m.

lee_runtime: Any deploys or infra changes in the last hour? Not aware of any. Runtime infra CPU/GPU fine. No autoscaler events.

maria_oncall: Sam — can you grab consumer group id and restart consumer if needed? Also toggle shadow mode for billing alerts to prevent customer emails.

sam_billing: consumer: usage-consumer-prod-v2. Restarting consumer now (rolling). Also setting billing.alerts.mode=shadow for affected accounts.

jordan_support: Notifying Tier 2 for the 3 customers. Preparing template: "We are investigating delayed usage reporting; no billing charges will be applied during investigation."

raj_analytics: running quick reconcile: running `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM emitter WHERE ts > now() - interval '45 minutes'` — results show ~2.0M tokens. Ledger writeback lag shows ~200k/s backlog.

maria_oncall: good. If restart doesn't clear lag in 5m, escalate to eng-runtime to inspect Kafka broker or consumer group offset commit errors. Also record incident for postmortem.

lee_runtime: seeing repeated commit errors in consumer logs: `OffsetCommit failed: BrokerNotAvailableException` — hitting one broker in the cluster. Spinning replacement.

sam_billing: after restart, consumer lag dropping slowly. Overages suppressed. I'll run a live reconcile job to flush pending counts and patch the ledger.

maria_oncall: ETA for broker replacement?

lee_runtime: new broker up in ~3m. will monitor.

jordan_support: Customer messages queued; sending interim update now.

raj_analytics: reconcile job started, estimated completion ~12m. We'll validate token parity after.

maria_oncall: thanks team. keep this thread for updates. I'll call out in 15m with status and postmortem owners. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: state=mitigated, details: consumer restart + broker replacement initiated. suppression=enabled for 3 accounts. Follow-up: postmortem required.
